kcfe01.title: Here for the snacks (and maybe love)
kcfe01.caption:
Taurus walked into the confessional for the crackers and walked out with a crush.
Who else showed up for the food and stayed for the person?

kcfe02.title: Aries waited four whole minutes
kcfe02.caption: Four minutes without a reply and Aries came through the curtain. One text back and suddenly the most patient sign alive. Tag your four-minute friend.

kcfe03.title: Gemini booked the booth twice
kcfe03.caption:
One Gemini is so over them. The other one kept the napkin. Turns out both of them like them, which is a first.
Which side of you is winning today?

kcfe04.title: Cancer still has the hoodie
kcfe04.caption: It's not a hoodie, it's a whole museum with plaques. Cancer misses who they were in it, and folds it into the give-back box anyway. What's in your ex museum?

kcfe05.title: Leo posted it for one viewer
kcfe05.caption:
The selfie was for nobody. The refreshing was for one person. Leo's new plan: skip the post, just say hi.
Be honest, who was your last story for?

kcfe06.title: Virgo brought a binder
kcfe06.caption: Three tabs, two appendices and a pressed flower, and the conclusion page is still blank. Virgo's answer was never going to be in the binder. Who needs to hear this?

kcfe07.title: Libra minded. A lot.
kcfe07.caption:
"I don't mind" three times on a date, then one full scream into a cushion about noodles. Practise it with Libra: I'd love noodles.
What do you actually want for dinner?

kcfe08.title: Scorpio is fine. Totally.
kcfe08.caption: Scorpio said fine five times and the lower third stopped believing it. The real answer took one question, and then a call to the best friend on the boom mic.

kcfe09.title: Sagittarius, month four of casual
kcfe09.caption: Month one: two mugs. Month four: a shared plant with a name tag. Sag is still calling it casual, but finally told the camera the truth. Next stop: telling them.

kcfe10.title: Capricorn's advice, for everyone else
kcfe10.caption: Three phones, three perfect pieces of advice, then one question about their own crush and the loading bar hit 99%. Tag the friend who should read their own texts.

kcfe11.title: Aquarius has no feelings (allegedly)
kcfe11.caption:
Emotionally unbothered, according to Aquarius. According to the heart monitor, very much bothered by one specific laugh.
Which sign is your group's unbothered one?

kcfe12.title: Pisces finally gets the chair
kcfe12.caption: Pisces finally gets the confessional chair and cries before the first question. A dog in a scarf, two snacks from one machine, a nice cloud. Zero regrets.

kcfe13.title: Everyone's in the booth at 2 a.m.
kcfe13.caption:
2:04 a.m. confessions: checking one thing, rereading old texts, typing a reply that will never send. Pisces is crying at a duck video.
Which booth are you in tonight?

kcfe14.title: Left on read: the support group
kcfe14.caption: Day three of left on read. One reread it forty ways, one is just near their phone, one made a casserole about it. Then the phone buzzed. It had died.

kcfe15.title: Single at the holiday dinner
kcfe15.caption:
"So, seeing anyone?" Four singles, four answers, one round of seconds. Single at the table and genuinely fine about it.
What's your answer this year?
